extractionMethod.note: Read directly via pdftotext -layout across both pages. Dense tabular contract sheet; single property so no cross-property mixup risk, but column alignment was double-checked against the header row (5 date-window columns) before transcription.

structuralFindings: Base meal plan is Half Board (HB) for all room categories — Fullboard and All-Inclusive are paid per-adult supplements on top, not separate base rates like Lantana.
Five pricing periods, not three: 23 Dec-3 Jan (highest/'peak'), 4 Jan-31 Mar, 1 Apr-15 Jul, 16 Jul-31 Aug, 1 Sep-22 Dec. Do not force these into Soroi's Peak/Shoulder/Green 3-season model.

Three property zones with different room categories: 'Superior & Deluxe' (Gardenview), 'Cottages, Suites & Seaview Villas' (Seaview), and 'The Residence' (2BR/3BR villas, priced per-person with pax-count surcharge tiers rather than a flat category rate).
The Residence villas have a base 'min pax' rate plus an explicit surcharge for 3rd/4th (2BR) or 5th/6th (3BR) occupant — a different pricing mechanic from every other category here.
Single supplement ('Double = Single occupancy') varies by season and does NOT apply to The Residence at all.
Children's policy is split into two separate tables (Superior & Deluxe vs The Residence) with different age brackets and discount structures — do not assume one applies to the other.
Long-stay discount here is 20% off contract rates AND 20% off F&B/spa/laundry for 21+ nights — a different threshold/shape from Soroi's 6/9/12-night ladder.
Groups of 12+ get 10% off all contract conditions, except during 23 Dec-3 Jan.
A KES East Africa Resident rate file also exists (Leopard Beach Resort Contract 2025-2026 EA KES Rates.pdf) — not extracted, out of scope for this non-resident extraction pass.
